headline: Curious about data. Focused on impact.
introduction: I am a Data Analyst passionate about transforming raw data into meaningful insights that support better decision-making. Using Power BI, and Excel, I analyse data, develop interactive dashboards and communicate findings through clear, actionable reports.
professionalBackground: My work and learning have covered business, customer, healthcare, energy, agriculture and operational data.
approach: My approach combines analytical thinking with practical tools: preparing and querying data, building visual reports, investigating performance indicators and translating results into useful observations.
careerGoals: I'm continuing to strengthen my analytical practice through hands-on projects and professional learning, and I'm interested in opportunities where I can contribute to data-informed decisions.
